ITQAN:v1p53/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p53/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p53/r5.claim: Another view excepts the nine verses beginning “Have you seen the one who turned away?” from al-Najm's Meccan classification.
ITQAN:v1p53/r5.anchor: وقيل ﴿ أفرأيت الذي تولى ﴾ الآيات التسع

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.claim: People who assume descent from Abraham and Moses entitles them to Paradise are condemned; Islahi redirects attention to those prophets' teachings and sacrifices.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.anchor: Their attention is directed to the teachings and sacrifices of these prophets

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.claim: The promise that a person’s work will be seen and repaid assures believers that even tiny good deeds count and warns that no small evil deed is ignored.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.anchor: the believers should rest assured that the smallest of their good deeds shall be taken notice of

STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.claim: The third section calls people to reflect on their creation and transitions to enduring truths in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham.
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.anchor: the third section (vv. 31–54) calls upon people to reflect upon their creation

STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.claim: This section then turns to perennial truths attested in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham.
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.anchor: transitions into a discussion of the perennial truths attested in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r1.claim: The preferred parse makes the nominative pronoun refer to the human and the accusative to his striving; الجزاء specifies the kind of verbal noun.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r1.anchor: أن الضمير المرفوع عائد على الإنسان، والمنصوب عائد على سعيه. والجزاء مصدر مبين للنوع.

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī allows the pronoun to refer to الجزاء, explained or replaced by the following noun, as in 21:3.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r2.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " ويجوز أن يكون الضمير للجزاء، ثم فسره بقوله " الجزاء "

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r3.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r3.claim: The Shaykh objects that an explanatory accusative needs a governor, while replacing a pronoun with an apparent noun as بدل is disputed and, in his view, disallowed.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r3.anchor: قال الشيخ: " وإذا كان تفسيرا للضمير المنصوب في " يجزاه "

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r4.claim: Al-Samīn answers that الجزاء can be عطف بيان, which is itself explanatory and a common construction.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r4.anchor: أن يكون عطف بيان، وعطف البيان يصدق عليه أنه مفسر

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r5.claim: A second answer is an omitted أعني; using it as an explanatory accusative is regular.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r5.anchor: أن ينتصب بإضمار أعني، وهي عبارة سائغة أيضا يسمون مثل ذلك تفسيرا.

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r6.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r6.claim: Abū al-Baqāʾ says الجزاء الأوفى is object of يجزاه rather than a verbal noun, since الأوفى describes recompense rather than the act.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r6.anchor: الجزاء الأوفى هو مفعول " يجزاه " وليس بمصدر لأنه وصفه بالأوفى

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r7.claim: Al-Samīn calls this likely mistaken: with the passive subject and pronoun already filling two roles, this makes the verb take three objects and strains the meaning.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r7.anchor: وهذا لا يبعد عن الغلط؛ لأنه يلزم أن يتعدى يجزى إلى ثلاثة مفاعيل.

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r8.claim: It could be rescued by making الجزاء بدل from the pronoun, avoiding a third object; al-Samīn says this is remote from Abū al-Baqāʾ’s intent and obscure.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r8.anchor: أراد أنه بدل من الهاء كما تقدم نقله عن الزمخشري

SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r9.claim: Al-Samīn rejects the objection that الأوفى cannot describe the act: it can do so metaphorically, as it does recompense; in reality only the rewarded person bears the quality.
SAMIN-DURR:53:41/r9.anchor: بل هو من صفاته مجاز، كما يوصف به المجزي به مجازا، فإن الحقيقة في كليهما منتفية، وإنما المتصف به حقيقة المجازى.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r1.claim: A person receives recompense for his effort; Arabic can say God recompensed him by his work, for his work, or directly with the work by omitting the preposition.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r1.anchor: أي يجزى الإنسان سعيه يقالأ : جزاه الله عز وجل بعمله

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r2.claim: الجزاء الأوفى may be a verbal noun specifying the kind of recompense; describing the recompense as most complete licenses describing its event likewise by association.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r2.anchor: مصدر مبين للنوع وإذا جاز وصف المجزي به بالأوفى

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r3.claim: Alternatively, الجزاء is the thing recompensed, effectively giving the verb three objects; some instead analyze it as an object after omission of a preposition.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r4.claim: Another analysis makes the pronoun refer to recompense rather than effort, with الجزاء الأوفى as apposition or explanatory substitute.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r4.anchor: وجوز أن يكون الضمير المنصوب في ( يجزاه ) للجزاء لا للسعي

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r5.speaker: أبو حيان
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r5.claim: Abu Hayyan objects that the analysis substitutes an explicit noun for a pronoun; al-Alusi says the correct position forbids this disputed construction.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#3/r5.anchor: وتعقبه أبو حيان أن فيهإبدال الظاهر من الضمير

NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r1.claim: The servant is requited for his striving; Arabic may make the deed a direct object by omitting the preposition.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r1.anchor: ثم يجزى العبد سعيه يقال جزاءه الله عمله وجزاه على عمله بحذف الجار

NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r2.claim: The pronoun can refer to the recompense, which is then explained by “the fullest recompense,” or the latter phrase can be an apposition.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p192#4/r2.anchor: ويجوز ان يكون الضمير للجزاء ثم فسره بقوله ﴿ الجزاء الأوفى ﴾ أو ابدله عنه

STUDYQURAN:53:41/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:41/r1.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:53:41/r1.claim: The fullest reward is the full reward God has promised people.
STUDYQURAN:53:41/r1.anchor: The fullest reward that God has promised to people (Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:53:41/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:41/r2.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:53:41/r2.claim: Some interpret the fullest reward as the vision of God.
STUDYQURAN:53:41/r2.anchor: according to some, is the vision of God (R)

QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r10.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r10.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r10.claim: People's striving differs: worldly pursuit loses, pursuit of Paradise profits, disciplining the self reaches God's approval, and striving in spiritual aspiration is thanked by God and guided to Him.
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r10.anchor: الناس في سعيهم مختلفون ؛ فمن كان سعيه في طلب الدنيا خسرت صفقته ، ومن كان سعيه في طلب الجنة ربحت صفقته

QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r11.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r11.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r11.claim: A sinner who strives to seek forgiveness and regrets the darkening of his record will receive reward, nearness, honor, and intimacy from God.
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r11.anchor: وأما المذنب - فإذا كان سعيه في طلب غفرانه ، وندم القلب على ما اسود من ديوانه ، فسوف يجد من الله الثواب والقربة والكرامة والزلفة

QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r12.claim: One who counts his breaths with God, attends to every shortcoming, and neglects no command will see his effort thanked in this life and the next; God addresses him directly as forgiven and thanked.
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r12.anchor: ومن كان سعيه في عد أنفاسه مع الله ؛ لا يعرج على تقصير ، ولا يفرط في مأمور فسيرى جزاء سعيه مشكورا في الدنيا والآخرة

QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r13.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r13.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r13.claim: The fullest recompense is the greatest and most exalted reward, neither cut off nor withheld.
QUSHAYRI:v3p251/r13.anchor: هو الجزاء الأكبر والأجل ، جزاء غير مقطوع ولا ممنوع

TAB-FULL:v22p81/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p81/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v22p81/r1.claim: Every worker will see their work on the Resurrection Day through its recompense, good or bad; no one is punished or rewarded for another's deeds.
TAB-FULL:v22p81/r1.anchor: لا يؤاخذ بعقوبة ذنب غير عامله، ولا يثاب على صالح عمله عامل غيره

TAB-FULL:v22p81/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p81/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v22p81/r2.claim: The rule answers the apostate who relied on another person's promise to bear his punishment: that promise cannot avail him because each worker is taken to account for their own work.
TAB-FULL:v22p81/r2.anchor: وإنما عنى بذلك: الذي رجع عن إسلامه بضمان صاحبه له أن يتحمل عنه العذاب، أن ضمانه ذلك لا ينفعه،

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r1.claim: In thumma yujzāhu, the pronoun refers to the person's effort; the verb can mean repaying someone for his work or effort.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r1.anchor: أي يجرى الإنسان سعيه، والضمير للسعي يقال: جزيت فلانا عمله وسعيه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r2.speaker: الشاعر
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r2.claim: The cited poem uses jazā for recompensing someone's effort, as evidence for the verb's sense.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r2.anchor: إن أز علقمة بن سعد سعيه ... لا أجزه ببلاء يوم واحد

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r3.claim: Al-jazāʾ al-awfā means the most complete and perfect recompense; Abu Ishaq glosses it as fully rewarding the deed.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69#2/r3.anchor: و {الجزاء الأوفى} الأكمل والأتم، قال أبو إسحاق: أي يجزى عمله أوفى جزاء

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#8/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#8/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#8/r1.claim: Yujzāhu means that he is recompensed for it.

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.claim: One parsing makes the pronoun refer to سعي: the person is rewarded for his effort; جزى can take two objects or three with a preposition, and the preposition may be omitted with the verb attached directly.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.anchor: الهاء ضمير السعي أي ثم يجزى الإنسان سعيه بالجزاء

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r6.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun refers to الجزاء: the person is given a reward, with الجزاء الأوفى explaining or appositive to an understood جزاء, as in 21:3.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r6.anchor: وفيه وجه آخر وهو أن الضمير للجزاء

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r7.claim: The fullest recompense suits righteous believers, prompting the objection that Hell is also called a plentiful recompense; Rāzī answers that Hell is fuller in harm than the benefit of sins, so it is complete from that perspective.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r7.anchor: الجزاء الأوفى على ما ذكرنا يليق بالمؤمنين الصالحين

BURSEVI:v9p207/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p207/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p207/r3.claim: A person is repaid with the fullest recompense for his work, good for good and evil for evil; al-jazāʾ is an accusative cognate object specifying kind.
BURSEVI:v9p207/r3.anchor: أي يجزي الإنسان بعسيه أي جزاء عمله يقال جزاه الله بعمله وجزاه على عمله

BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.speaker: الوراق
BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.claim: Al-Warrāq maps striving to beginning, middle, and end; at the end, annihilation is rewarded with witnessing and subsistence with bodily nurture, including lawful provisions deferred during the path.
BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.anchor: قالل الوراق : وإن ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى ذلك في بدايته وإن سعيه سوف يرى

TABATABAI:53:40-43/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r4.claim: Wafa means completeness, since a complete thing fulfills all its required qualities; the fullest recompense is the most complete reward.
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r4.anchor: الوفاء بمعنى التمام لأن الشيء التام يفي بجميع ما يطلب من صفاته

TABATABAI:53:40-43/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r5.claim: The pronoun refers to striving, meaning the person is repaid for his work with the fullest recompense.
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r5.anchor: وضمير { يجزاه } للسعي الذي هو العمل والمعنى

TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.claim: Then the effort itself is repaid in full: lasting reward for obedience, with the pronoun referring to the effort; on Judgment Day the servant sees it and receives its fullest recompense.
TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.anchor: والهاء في يجزاه عائدة إلى السعي والمعنى أنه يرى العبد سعيه يوم القيامة

THALABI:v9p154/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p154/r3.speaker: الأخفش
THALABI:v9p154/r3.claim: Al-Akhfash says both جزيته الجزاء and جزيته بالجزاء mean the same; an unnamed poet's line combines both constructions.
THALABI:v9p154/r3.anchor: الأخفش: يقال: جزيته الجزاء وجزيته بالجزاء

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r6.claim: He will then be repaid with the fullest recompense.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r6.anchor: ثم يجزاه } يجزى عليه { الجزاء الأوفى } الأتم

ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r15.speaker: author
ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r15.claim: Afterward the person receives the fullest recompense, so one's future is the product of one's striving.
ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r15.anchor: Sonra ona en dolgun karşılık verilecektir. Bu suretle insanın istikbâli sa‘yinin mâhasali olacak demektir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r5.claim: At the end of judgment everyone receives the full recompense for what they did.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r5.anchor: Sözü edilen yargılamanın sonunda herkese yaptıklarının karşılığı tastamam verilecektir

NAHHAS:v4p276/r14.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p276/r14.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p276/r14.claim: The form is a verbal noun and its pronoun refers back to the effort, which receives its fullest recompense because God fulfills His promise and warning.
NAHHAS:v4p276/r14.anchor: مصدر والهاء كناية عن السعي الأوفى لأن الله عز وجل أوفى لهم بما وعد وأوعد

ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r2.claim: The servant's deed is recompensed with the fullest reward.

NASHR:v2p81/r7.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p81/r7.speaker: أبو عمرو
NASHR:v2p81/r7.claim: Abū ʿAmr opens the listed non-verse-final words on the routes that incline verse endings; for موسى he follows his usual between-vowels reading where imāla is transmitted.
NASHR:v2p81/r7.anchor: فإن أبا عمرو يفتح جميع ذلك من طريق المميلين له رءوس الآي لأنه ليس برأس آية

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r2.claim: The fullest and most complete recompense is given to a person for his striving.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r2.anchor: {ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى} الأكمل والأتم أي: يجزى الإنسان بسعيه،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r3.claim: Both constructions, repaying someone his effort and repaying him for it, are Arabic; the cited couplet uses both.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r3.anchor: يقال: جزيت فلانا سعيه وبسعيه، قال الشاعر: إن أجز علقمة بن سعد سعيه

BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r3.claim: The verb means the servant is repaid for his effort, with a preposition omitted; alternatively, it is a verbal noun, or its pronoun refers to recompense and al-jazāʾ is an appositive.
BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r3.anchor: أي يجزى العبد سعيه بالجزاء الأوفر

BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r3.claim: Recompense is complete: good is multiplied, evil is repaid equivalently for whom God wills, and He forgives much; the warning is a reminder.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r3.anchor: قال : { الجزاء الأوفى * } أي الإثم الأكمل , إن كان خيرا فمع المضاعفة , وإن كان غيره فعلى السواء لمن أراد الله ذلك له ويعفو عن كثير

DURR-FULL:v7p658/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p658/r4.speaker: دراج أبو السمح
DURR-FULL:v7p658/r4.claim: Darraj says the passage was revealed after a man who could not get a mount from the Prophet was offered transport by another man so he could catch the army.
DURR-FULL:v7p658/r4.anchor: عن دراج أبي السمح قال: خرجت سرية غازية فسأل رجل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يحمله فقال: لا أجد ما أحملك عليه

DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Prophet would recite these verses, then say the istirjaʿ formula and become subdued.
DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قرأ {وأن ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى وأن سعيه سوف يرى ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى} استرجع واستكان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r4.claim: The recompense clause is the point of the preceding statement about seeing one's effort.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r4.anchor: وقوله : { ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى } هو المقصود من الجملة .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r5.claim: Thumma marks rank rather than elapsed time, since the recompense matters more than displaying the deed or its recipient.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r5.anchor: و { ثم } للتراخي الرتبي لأن حصول الجزاء أهم من إظهاره أو إظهار المجزي عنه .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r6.claim: The object pronoun refers to the effort: the person is recompensed for it or by it, with the preposition omitted in a common construction.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r6.anchor: وضمير النصب في قوله : { يجزاه } عائد إلى السعي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r7.claim: Awfā derives from completeness; its comparative form intensifies fullness rather than comparing rewards, meaning that recompense fully matches good or evil deeds.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r7.anchor: والأوفى : اسم تفضيل من الوفاء وهو التمام والكمال ، والتفضيل مستعمل هنا في القوة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r8.claim: Al-jazāʾ al-awfā is accusative as an absolute object specifying the kind of action.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r8.anchor: وانتصب { الجزاء الأوفى } على المفعول المطلق المبين للنوع .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r9.claim: Abraham's prayer not to be disgraced on the day people are raised echoes the promised final recompense.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r9.anchor: وقد حكى الله عن إبراهيم { ولا تخزني يوم يبعثون } ( الشعراء : 87 ) .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r6.claim: Full recompense is a threat for unbelievers and a promise for believers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r6.anchor: وفي قوله: ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى وعيد للكافرين ووعد للمؤمنين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r1.claim: The pronoun in ‘he will be recompensed’ refers back to the person’s effort.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى يجزاه الهاء عائدة على السعي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82#2/r2.claim: Al-jazāʾ al-awfā means the most complete and perfect recompense.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.claim: A person's deeds will be seen on Judgment Day, as in 9:105; God will inform people of them and repay them fully, good for good and evil for evil.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.anchor: أي: يوم القيامة، كما قال تعالى: {وقل اعملوا فسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله والمؤمنون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r2.claim: Al-awfa means the fullest or most abundant recompense.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r2.anchor: وهكذا قال هاهنا: {ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى} أي: الأوفر.

JISHUMI:v9p6660/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r8.claim: Jazāʾ means recompense; both constructions with and without bi are attested, as the cited poetic line illustrates.
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r8.anchor: والجزاء: المكافأة، ويقال: جزيته الجزاء، وجزيته بالجزاء، قال الشاعر: إن أجز علقمة بن سعد سعيه ... لم أجزه ببلاء يوم واحد

JISHUMI:v9p6660/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r9.claim: Jazāʾ and ajr are synonymous terms.

JISHUMI:v9p6660/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r14.claim: Al-jazāʾ is accusative as the second object; the attached pronoun is the first object.
JISHUMI:v9p6660/r14.anchor: الجزاء نصب؛ لأنه المفعول الثاني، والمفعول الأول الهاء

JISHUMI:v9p6661/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r17.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r17.claim: Each receives the fullest recompense for his striving, complete because it is lasting reward in the everlasting abode.
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r17.anchor: ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى أي: يكافأ على سعيه الجزاء الأكمل؛ لأنه ثواب دائم في دار البقاء

JISHUMI:v9p6661/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r18.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r18.claim: Another view says people first learn their deeds and are then recompensed, matching thumma's sequencing force.
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r18.anchor: وقيل: يعرف أعماله ثم يجازى عليها؛ لأن (ثم) للتعقيب

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r8.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r8.claim: The servant is repaid for his effort; جزاه الله عمله can omit the preposition, or the pronoun can refer to the reward explained by الجزاء الأوفى.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r8.anchor: ثم يجزى العبد سعيه ، يقال : جزاه الله عمله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r9.claim: He compares the wording to 21:3, وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p427#2/r9.anchor: أو أبدله عنه ، كقوله تعالى : { وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا }

MUQATIL:53:33-42/r9.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:53:33-42/r9.speaker: author
MUQATIL:53:33-42/r9.claim: Each person is given the full recompense for worldly deeds.
MUQATIL:53:33-42/r9.anchor: يوفيه جزاء عمله في الدنيا كاملا

QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r2.speaker: الأخفش
QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r2.claim: Al-Akhfash says jazaytuhu al-jazāʾ and jazaytuhu bi-l-jazāʾ are equivalent constructions, both used by the cited poet.

QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r3.speaker: الشاعر
QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r3.claim: The poet's line contrasts the two equivalent forms for recompensing a person's striving.
QURTUBI-FULL:53:40-42/r3.anchor: إن أجز علقمة بن سعد سعيه لم أجزه ببلاء يوم واحد
